row.evidence: SysAid documents no SCIM endpoint: users come in through vendor-run repository syncs that pull from Entra ID (about every 24 hours), Okta, OneLogin, Google Workspace or LDAP, plus SAML SSO add-ons that can create users at first login.
row.notes: New row. Professional $89 per agent/month (quote form; billing period not stated) and Enterprise custom from 20 agents. The pricing page lists MFA & SSO as a platform security feature, not per plan. No SCIM anywhere in the docs index or developer reference. Provisioning is SysAid-run pull sync (Marketplace add-ons): Entra ID (~24 h), Okta Repository (API token, custom interval), OneLogin Repository (~12 h, needs OneLogin SSO), Google User Repository (can disable deleted Google users) and LDAP. SAML SSO add-ons (Okta, OneLogin, Office 365, Entra SSO Connector) can JIT-create users. Okta's OIN SysAid app is SWA only. The REST API (OAuth client credentials, 24 h tokens) creates agents and end users, manages groups and deletes end users; it is listed as included on Professional and Enterprise. Webhooks cover service records only. CSV import covers end users only.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: SSO from the page-wide 'MFA & SSO' security line; SSO is configured through Marketplace add-ons.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence: the documentation index (llms.txt) and developer reference contain no SCIM page or endpoint; directory integrations pull users from the IdP instead.

auth.notes: App Key (client ID and secret) exchanged at POST /v1/access-tokens for a bearer token, default lifetime 24 hours.

capabilities.notes: update_user and delete_user are documented for end users; agents can be created, regrouped and converted to or from end users (removes or grants agent roles).

webhooks_user_events.notes: Supported webhook events are sr.created and sr.updated (service records) only.

okta.notes: OIN functionality table ticks only SWA (checked in rendered page). SysAid's own Okta guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app plus the Okta Repository pull sync (directory_sync).

entra.notes: No SysAid tutorial in Microsoft Learn's SaaS app index; SysAid pulls users with its own Entra ID add-on and offers an Entra SSO Connector add-on.

onelogin.notes: From SysAid's own OneLogin guides (SAML Custom Connector + OneLogin Repository add-on).

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run user repository sync from Entra ID, Okta, OneLogin, Google Workspace and LDAP/AD
